instructions: Cross-platform clipboard MCP server. Provides two tools: clipboard_copy (writes text to the clipboard) and clipboard_copy_file (writes the contents of a file at an absolute path to the clipboard — useful when content has already been written to a temp file). The backend is auto-detected per OS and environment: pbcopy on macOS; wl-copy on Linux Wayland; xclip or xsel on Linux X11; clip.exe on WSL; clip on Cygwin/MSYS. When no native clipboard utility is reachable, falls back to an OSC 52 terminal escape sequence written to /dev/tty, which works over SSH and in many modern terminals (tmux, kitty, iTerm2, Windows Terminal, Alacritty).
